mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days by lowering discount rates and increasing equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
